owner_scope: controlled single host and shared existing account; no cross-host fencing or account isolation claim
history_gap: bounded full revalidation of every frozen source and deduplicated ancestor; never select a new Latest

locks.writer_serialization: covers one transaction, including immutable preparation
locks.admission_gate: short current-state operations and final durable head confirmation

execution_lease.scope: in-flight execution including queued or abandoned decode producers until actual source work and captures end

request_metadata_budget.lifetime: one external owner request, from scan through final publication; independent execute/open starts a fresh ledger
request_metadata_budget.immutable_evidence: once per source-qualified identity and encoded revision in the same request
request_metadata_budget.layout_identity_and_explicit_reads: full logical layout demand plus each explicit logical read, conservatively cumulative
request_metadata_budget.shared_decode_producer: neutral fee trace; each waiter replays into its own ledger on success or cache hit

cache_caps.borrowed_objects_and_active_old_contexts: additional lifetime and memory; not included in cache ownership caps

measurement.cold_start_scope: fresh daemon process; database and OS caches not flushed
